terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Next.js 14 dev server on http://localhost:3000 in visual-regression bypass mode (no database). Serves the real production routes (for example /sales, /pos, /crm) without auth so UI work needs no persisted records. For authenticated or data-dependent testing, set a disposable DATABASE_URL secret, run `npx prisma db push`, then run the app without VISREG_BYPASS_AUTH.
